title: Acid-Base Indicator Titration
body: A learner titrates 20 cm^3 of acetic acid (CH3COOH) with 0.1 mol/dm^3 sodium hydroxide (NaOH). The endpoint is reached when 15 cm^3 of NaOH has been added. The balanced equation is: CH3COOH + NaOH -> CH3COONa + H2O. Calculate the concentration of the acetic acid.
oer: Siyavula Grade 12 Physical Sciences - Acids and Bases
